_note: Copy for the Welcome screen that opens on startup. {owner} and {brand} are filled in from site.json. Each topic is one entry in the Contents list: `icon` must be a symbol id in public/icons.svg, `body` is a list of paragraphs, and `open` (optional) is an app id from registry.jsx that gets an Open button. The first topic is shown when the window opens.

topics.title: What is {brand}?
body: {brand} is {owner}'s portfolio, built to look and work like a Windows 98 / ME desktop.
Each part of the portfolio is a program. Open one and it runs in its own window, the way it would have on a PC at the turn of the millennium.
Pick a topic on the left for a quick tour, or close this window and start exploring.

topics.title: Opening Programs
body: Double-click an icon on the desktop to open that program. You can also click an icon once and press Enter.
Or click the Start button in the bottom-left corner and choose a program from the menu.
Every open program gets a button on the taskbar along the bottom of the screen.

topics.title: Working with Windows
body: Drag a window by its title bar to move it. Drag any edge or corner to resize it.
The three buttons at the top right of a window minimize, maximize and close it. Double-clicking the title bar maximizes it too.
Click a window to bring it to the front. Click its taskbar button to minimize it, and again to bring it back.
On a phone or a narrow screen, each window fills the screen instead.

topics.title: What's on the Desktop
body: About Me: a profile page, styled after an early MySpace profile.
My Projects: a folder for each project. Double-click a file to open it in Notepad, Photos or Media Player.
Homework: a folder for each degree and certification, with its details and any certificates or documents.
Experience: past roles. Click a row to see the details.
Skills: a Device Manager style list. Click a skill to open its properties.
Contact Me: write a message and click Send. It really is delivered.
resume.exe: run the setup wizard to download the resume.
Solitaire: the classic card game, for a break.
